title: Audit and archive 6 verified non-roadmap landed task records
goal: Prove git commit ancestry on origin/main, run each task's acceptance command on current HEAD with >0 passing checks, and archive 6 verified non-roadmap open task records (T-CODEXGMCPTERMINAL-1, T-CODEXHARNESSID-1, T-CODEXHARNESSID-2, T-CODEXRELEASESYNCQUAL-2, T-CODEXSOCKETPARITY-1, T-CODEXRELEASE-1) into .agents/tasks/done/.
notes: Archives the 6 non-debt non-roadmap tasks whose implementation commits are proven ancestors of origin/main and whose accept.cmd ran real passing verification on current Linux x86_64 HEAD. Leaves tasks whose accept.cmd matches 0 tests on Linux or after refactors (T-LAUNCHLEAK-1, T-RELEASE51-1, T-RELEASE52-1, T-SLUG-1, T-PRUNECLOSEDADAPTERS-3) or fails on removed targets (T-UNBLOCK-2, T-MAINGREEN-1) untouched in .agents/tasks/.

reuse.reason: Reuses the existing susi.task_record/v1 closed-task schema and task_records validation harness without adding code or dependencies.
